causal_eligibility.month_cutoff: last benchmark session in every calendar month from 2012-01 through 2025-08 inclusive
causal_eligibility.stock_presence: stock must contain an exact bar on the benchmark cutoff
causal_eligibility.source_scope: symbols from the sealed 12080-row NASDAQ shadow denominator only
causal_eligibility.source_vintage_limit: reject any post-denominator-lock row whose timestamp is on or before 2026-03-30
causal_eligibility.future_append_policy: ignore rows after 2026-03-30 and prove selected query identity is unchanged
causal_eligibility.invalid_prefix_policy: exclude a prefix with any missing required field invalid OHLC nonpositive price or negative volume

prefix_quality.A: at least 252 rows, zero critical issues, zero greater-than-threefold close discontinuities, and cumulative zero-volume rows not above max(5,floor(0.02*prefix_rows))
prefix_quality.B: at least 252 rows, zero critical issues, and at least one greater-than-threefold close discontinuity or cumulative zero-volume rows above max(5,floor(0.02*prefix_rows))

liquidity.measure: median(close*volume) over exactly the trailing 252 stock sessions ending at cutoff
liquidity.population: all causal A/B candidates with an exact cutoff bar
liquidity.rank: ascending (median_dollar_volume_252,symbol), one-based rank divided by monthly population size

selection.underfill: retain and report shortfall without replacement

prefix_binding.stock: canonical-ohlcv-prefix-v1 digest from first stored row through selected cutoff
prefix_binding.benchmark: canonical-ohlcv-prefix-v1 digest from first stored row through monthly cutoff
